dlazy-kling-v3 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launch of powerful video generation with Kling v3, supporting high-quality text-to-video and image-to-video.
- Provides detailed command-line options for customizing video generation (prompt, images, aspect ratio, duration, mode, sound, etc.).
- Includes error handling guidelines for common issues like missing API key, insufficient balance, and input errors.
- Offers clear user guidance for setup, API authentication, and resolution steps for common errors.
- Documentation includes example commands and expected output format.
